results.title: Xi’an cadastral map query instructions
results.note: Queries by unit code/address, but require government portal login and QR verification; no open bulk vector API identified.

assessment: Search found parcel ID and cadastral-map lookup functionality for verified government users. It did not establish anonymous vector access or an open stable-ID query service.
note: Native-language discovery only; does not change the historical registry or assert that no source exists.
